validation.independent_static_review: tv_browse_flow: loader/main and final audio increments reviewed

limitations: The album and exact track row identity were observed, but decoded audio, currentSrc retention, playback advance, pause, seeks, resume, and normal UI stop did not pass.
The two Similar/ThemeMedia 404 responses are auxiliary; the core universal 400 and following Playing/Progress/Stopped 404 responses remain explicit failures.
The FLAC HTTP400 error body was read once (116 bytes) only for whitelisted diagnostics; no successful response body was read.
The request contains container|codec syntax; the observed invalid_audio_request is not by itself a universal claim that every such selector is the only cause.
MP3 cleanup used its exact saved token via independent API, not UI acceptance. FLAC dismissed the observed error dialog then completed actual UI logout and exact-token rejection.

Both failed runs retain private storageState files for audit: MP3 contains the exact now-rejected token, while FLAC is already signed out with zero stored user credentials. No effective session remains.
Prior source12 names and source15 subtitle/TV input archives remain unchanged.
Process pins were checked around explicitly frozen instances; the shared independent logout proof is not atomically cancellable across an unexpected instance replacement.
